messages.content: What is the common ancestor of lion and zebra?

function.name: calculate_fibonacci_sequence
function.description: Calculates fibonacci sequence up to a specified limit. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

limit.description: The upper limit of the fibonacci sequence to be calculated.

show_sequence.description: Optional parameter to decide whether to print the fibonacci sequence or not. Default is False.

message.content:
The most recent common ancestor of a lion (Panthera leo) and a zebra (Equus quagga) is the last common ancestor of all placental mammals (eutherians).  
Lion and zebra belong to different orders—Carnivora and Perissodactyla, respectively—so their lineages diverged at the base of the placental mammal tree.
